{{Quote|Halt where you are. I am Yadira Ban, Padawan of the Jedi Order. I was sent to protect the general, and you will not pass.|Yadira Ban|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Yadira Ban''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
[[File:Yadira_battle.png|thumb|left|Yadira Ban prepares to defend her charge]]
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], Yadira Ban was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who had constructed her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], [[Gender/Legends|her]] final trial was to face a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in combat. She was assigned to protect an Imperial defector referred to as "[[The General]]" while he was aboard the ''[[Brentaal Star]]'', a Republic [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]].<ref name="TOR" />

During transit, the Imperial [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Black Talon]]'' attacked the ''Brentaal Star''. Ban was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when Imperial boarders confronted her on the ''Brentaal Star''{{'s}} engine deck.<ref name="TOR" />
